# Spell Trail

> Spell Trail is a free, ad-free spelling app for kids in grades 1–8: five-minute practice trails, your own weekly word lists, and no account needed.

Spell Trail is made by Wishful Coders (https://wishfulcoders.com), a one-person
studio building ad-free, privacy-first apps for families. It is free forever:
no trial, no subscription, no premium tier, no ads, no trackers, and no account.
Progress is stored in the browser on the device. The code is open source under
the AGPL-3.0.

## What it does

- Five-minute spelling trails of 3 to 16 words.
- Six tiers of 64 hand-written words covering grades 1 to 8 (roughly ages 6 to 14).
- Parents can paste in this week's spelling list from school.
- Five question modes: listen and spot, fill the gap, build the word, memory
  trail, and typing checkpoint.
- Missed words come back once in the same trail, then wait in review camp until
  answered cleanly twice.
- Up to six players share one device with separate progress.
- Runs in any modern browser on iPad, Chromebook, Android, or a laptop. Nothing to install.
